Repository files navigation Eavesong _Eaves_ as in eavesdropping, the talk you overhear: Eavesong listens for what people say about your product. Eavesong watches the places people talk about products (Hacker News, Reddit, Bluesky, X, YouTube, GitHub and more) for posts about your product and your competitors. It puts them in one inbox, drafts replies with your own AI provider when a reply would help, and reports how often your product comes up compared with your competitors. It runs on your own server. Your tokens, your data and your AI prompts stay there. Eavesong only reads. It never posts, comments, votes or replies for you. Drafts are suggestions you copy and post yourself, which is also what keeps your accounts in good standing on communities that ban automated posting. What it does Inbox: every post or comment that links your domain or mentions your product name, with where it was posted, who wrote it, and a link to reply. Mark items handled or ignored. Reply drafts: for each new mention the AI decides whether a reply is worth sending (most mentions don't need one), drafts a short answer when it is, and flags bug reports and complaints for a personal look. Competitors: add competitor names, and their mentions are collected and labelled separately. Search: with a readonly Google Search Console key, each project gets a Search tab with clicks, impressions, the searches it appears for, its top pages, searches where it is almost on page one, and sitemap status. Refreshed daily. A "What to do next" list turns the numbers into specific actions, each naming the search and the page: titles that rank but don't get clicked, pages close to page one, searches with no page that answers them, pages competing for the same search, and searches rising or falling. With an AI provider set, "Ask AI for a plan" writes them up as a prioritised plan. Traffic: with a readonly Google Analytics 4 key, each project gets a Traffic tab: visitors, visits and page views against the 28 days before, visitors per day, where visitors came from, landing pages and the most read pages. "From the places Eavesong listens" puts the visits from Hacker News, Reddit, Bluesky and the other sources next to the mentions Eavesong found there, which shows where people talk about you without linking. The same serviceaccount key as Search Console works; it needs the Google Analytics Admin and Data APIs enabled and Viewer access to the property. Each project is matched to the property whose web data stream measures its domain. Report: mentions by source, share of voice between your product and competitors, and the items that needed a reply, over 7, 30 or 90 days. Your own accounts: posts by your own usernames are recognised and kept out of the inbox. Notifications: opt in to alerts for mentions needing attention, competitor mentions and sitemap errors through Slack, Discord or a generic webhook. Daily and weekly summaries can use the same dest
items.author: misonic
items.descZh: Eavesong 是一款自托管的只读型产品舆论监控工具，专注于在 Hacker News、Reddit、Bluesky、X、GitHub 等主流社区中窃听关于用户产品及竞品的讨论。它将所有相关提及聚合至统一收件箱，利用用户本地部署的 AI 服务生成定制化回复草稿，并对 Bug 和投诉进行人工标记，严格遵循“只读不发帖”的原则以维护账号安全。其核心亮点在于与只读的 Google Search Console 和 Google Analytics 4 深度集成，每日刷新搜索表现，并对比近 28 天流量变化，自动生成包含“排名高但无点击”、“接近首页页面”等具体指标的行动清单，甚至能借助 AI 输出优先级优化方案。此外，系统支持竞品声量份额对比（7/30/90天周期），并通过 Slack 或 Webhook 推送定制警报，非常适合需要高度数据自主权、追求社媒舆情与 SEO 搜索表现联动分析的团队。
items.quote: Eavesong 会关注人们谈论产品的地方（Hacker News、Reddit、Bluesky、X、YouTube、GitHub 等），以获取有关您的产品和竞争对手的帖子

items.author: X-Geek
items.descZh: MouseChase 是一款创新的放置类解谜游戏，将策略布局与跑酷动作无缝融合，背景设定在充满机关与陷阱的奇幻世界中，旨在为玩家提供短时高密度的脑力与反应挑战。核心功能允许玩家在关卡中自由放置角色并触发自动奔跑，通过实时路径规划和环境互动解决动态谜题，同时支持自定义角色外观与技能组合。亮点包括基于物理引擎的流畅动作表现，角色移动帧率稳定在 60fps 以上，平均关卡加载时间低于 2 秒，且内置的自适应难度系统能根据玩家表现动态调整谜题复杂度。适用场景涵盖通勤途中的休闲益智、朋友间的短时对战以及喜欢策略与动作结合的中度玩家。
items.quote: MouseChase – 一款放置奔跑类益智游戏

items.author: sorlia7z
items.descZh: Answer me with HTML 是一种创新的 AI Agent 技能，旨在解决传统文本答案可读性差的问题，通过生成单页 HTML 来呈现复杂问题的答案。其核心功能是让 AI Agent 能够自动编写 HTML 页面，将答案转化为结构化、可视化的网页内容。亮点在于，模型只需编写约 1/8 的 tokens 即可生成完整页面，相比手写 HTML 节省大量成本，且生成的页面支持离线访问、单文件部署，极大提升了答案的可读性和实用性。该工具适用于需要清晰呈现复杂信息的场景，如技术文档、数据分析、教育演示等，帮助用户以更直观的方式获取知识。项目还提供了丰富的示例和基准测试，方便开发者评估和优化生成效果。
items.quote: 用 HTML 回答我——这是一种代理技能，可以用您可以实际阅读的单页 HTML 来回答难题。

items.descZh: ESPWatchtower 是一款基于超低成本 ESP8266 开发板（约3至4美元）的自主式家庭网络哨兵与蜜罐系统，旨在提供无订阅费的7x24小时本地安全防护。其核心功能包括部署三个高仿真诱饵蜜罐（分别模拟 Telnet 终端、路由器管理后台和 IP 摄像头流），用以捕获入侵者的 IP、账号和暴力破解密码。同时，该设备内置网络健康追踪器，通过持续 ping 目标主机实时记录延迟、丢包及断网时长，并在停电时通过 Discord 推送即时警报。所有安全审计日志均持久化保存至本地 LittleFS 闪存，确保重启或断电不丢失证据，且支持 Tailscale 远程访问暗色仪表盘及 WakeonLAN 远程唤醒。该方案非常适合预算敏感的家庭实验室用户，以低于0.5瓦的功耗构建无云依赖的本地安全防御前线。

items.desc: description: Connect SongUp AI to Cursor, VS Code, Claude Code, Zapier, Make or n8n with one MCP URL. Find AI songs, start a custom song in any of 76 languages and find audio tools. No signin. title: SongUp AI MCP Server for AI Agents and Automation image: https://www.songupai.com/images/ogdefault.png?v=3 Server URL https://www.songupai.com/mcp/agents Transport: Streamable HTTP. Authentication: none. Every tool is readonly. Using ChatGPT or Claude? Add the [ChatGPT app](/chatgptapp) or the [Claude connector](/claudeconnector) instead, which play songs right in the chat. Coding assistants Cursor. Add to \~/.cursor/mcp.json (or .cursor/mcp.json in a project): { "mcpServers": { "songupai": { "url": "https://www.songupai.com/mcp/agents" } } } VS Code (GitHub Copilot). Add to .vscode/mcp.json: { "servers": { "songupai": { "type": "http", "url": "https://www.songupai.com/mcp/agents" } } } Claude Code. Run in a terminal: claude mcp add transport http songupai https://www.songupai.com/mcp/agents Windsurf. Add to \~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp\_config.json: { "mcpServers": { "songupai": { "serverUrl": "https://www.songupai.com/mcp/agents" } } } Zapier, Make and n8n Each of these has an MCP client that connects to the server URL above. Zapier: add a step with the MCP Client app, create a connection with the server URL, choose Streamable HTTP and no authentication, then pick a SongUp AI tool as the action. Make: add the MCP Client module, create a connection with the server URL and no authentication, then choose a tool and map its inputs. n8n: give an AI Agent node the MCP Client Tool, set the endpoint to the server URL, the transport to HTTP Streamable and authentication to None. Ideas: post a song in your customer's language to Slack each week, or send a birthday contact a link that opens the SongUp AI song maker with their song idea filled in. Tools find_songs: a song language, optional words of genre, mood or occasion, and how many songs (up to 10). Returns songs from the SongUp AI library, each with a direct link to its audio. start_custom_song: a song idea (occasion, names, story, mood or style, up to 500 characters) and an optional language. Returns a link that opens the SongUp AI song maker with the idea filled in. The song itself is made on songupai.com with a SongUp AI account. find_audio_tool: what you want to do with your audio. Returns up to three SongUp AI browser tools with a link to each, such as the stem separator, vocal remover, mashup maker or audio editor. The tools never create songs, take payment or change anything. Library songs are readymade examples, not made from your words. To make songs from your own words in code, Zapier, Make or n8n, use the [SongUp AI API](/developers). Privacy The server receives only the tool inputs your app sends. It needs no account, does not store these requests or link them to a person, and sets no cookies. Details are in our [privacy policy](/privacyaiapps). Help and support Write to [support@songupai.com](mailto:support@songupai.com) or use the [contact page](/contact), and include the app you connected from. Want a full song with vocals now? Make one on [songupai.com](/create). Limitedtime offer Commercial license included Your song on every platform · Pro for $1 Make it today, release it on Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube and TikTok. Commercial license included. and 9 more platforms Get Pro for $1[ Create a song ](/create?via=site%5Fbanner&via%5Fcampaign=%2Fmcpserver) [No track to work on? Make one from scratch.Type an idea or your own lyrics and SongUp AI composes the whole song — music and vocals. Your first one is free. The API is not settled: any release may change or remove exported identifiers, and the changelog marks each break. Pin an exact version to avoid one. Read the [changelog](/libtmux/libtmuxts/blob/master/packages/libtmux/CHANGELOG.md) before you upgrade. Is this for you? Yes, if you drive tmux from a program — an agent that runs commands and reads what they printed, a workspace launcher, a test harness, a dashboard — and you want the terminal's state as typed data rather than as parsed strings. Probably not, if you want a .tmux.conf generator or a TUI. This library controls a running server; it does not write your tmux configuration. The idea in one line: read the whole server once into an immutable snapshot, then query it like data. Quickstart $ bun add libtmux npm, pnpm, yarn $ npm i libtmux $ pnpm add libtmux $ yarn add libtmux Requires [Bun](https://bun.sh) 1.3.14+ or Node 22+, and tmux 3.3a or newer. The version that counts is the running daemon's. An older daemon, or an executable that would start one, is refused with [VersionTooLowError](https://libtmux.org/en/ts/latest/reference/er

items.descZh: libtmux/libtmuxts 是一款面向 Node.js、Bun 和 TypeScript 生态的类型化 tmux 控制库，目前处于 Alpha 阶段，API 尚未稳定，需要固定版本使用。其核心设计是将运行中的 tmux 服务器状态一次性读取为不可变快照，再以声明式查询的方式像操作数据一样获取终端信息，同时保证零运行时依赖。亮点在于提供完整的 TypeScript 类型支持，让终端状态以类型化数据而非解析后的字符串形式呈现，显著降低开发中的类型错误风险。适用场景包括需要编程控制 tmux 的自动化 agent、工作区启动器、测试框架和仪表板等，但不适合用于生成 .tmux.conf 配置文件或构建 TUI 界面。运行环境要求 Bun 1.3.14+ 或 Node 22+，且 tmux 版本不低于 3.3a，版本不符会直接抛出 VersionTooLowError 拒绝执行。

items.descZh: Sparta 是一款专为小团队首次合规审计设计的自托管软件，旨在以极低的入门成本替代昂贵的重型合规平台。它提供了一个团队自有的工作空间，用于统一管理控制措施、政策版本、证据收集及审计历史，覆盖 ISO 27001、SOC 2、ISO 42001、GDPR 等六大框架。核心亮点在于一次性 799 美元即可解锁全部六个框架（或免费体验 ISO 42001 版本），通过 Cloudflare 部署并提供带完整性哈希值的证据导出与自动化集成检查。软件还支持 Slack、Linear 等工具集成，具备明确的责任分配、自动邮件警报及面向客户的信任中心，显著提升审计准备效率。该方案非常适合预算有限、处于首次审计阶段且未来计划向 Vanta 或 Drata 平台过渡的小型团队。
items.quote: 面向首次审计的自托管合规软件。为六种框架整理证据。一次性支付 799 美元，或通过 ISO 42001 免费开始。需要 Cloudflare。
